name: 4:15 9-2 Fastest Age up into Keshik for Mongols
author: TheIncan

notes: Drop TC onto @resource/resource_wood.webp@, Send khan to scout, speed arrow, 5 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.png@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ nearest your tc, 1 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.png@ to build @building_mongols/ovoo.png@. villager that builds ovoo > gather @resource/resource_gold.png@  5 vills on wood gather 50 @resource/resource_wood.png@ then begin to collect @resource/sheep.png@
2 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ rally onto @resource/resource_food.png@@resource/sheep.png@  Take 4 of your vills on wood and put them on a ctrl group for age up.

3@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@>@resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_wood.png@  be aware when your vills drop off the 140 wood, try not to rally all vills onto the same straggler you chopped inititally. i send usually just 1 vill to the initial straggler if it is close. your 150 wood will be spent on stable built in ovoo range.

4@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ pulled from @resource/resource_food.png@ build @landmark_mongols/deer-stones.png@/@landmark_mongols/the-silver-tree.png@ These 4 vills need to be shiftclicked to go to seperate resources after the age up. depending on your build this varies i usually go 2@resource/resource_gold.png@,1@resource/resource_wood.png@,1@resource/resource_food.png@

1@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@@resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_gold.png@       1@resource/resource_wood.png@@unit_worker/villager-mongols.png@ >@abilities/repair.png@@building_military/stable.png@ 1 vill around this time will be pulled from wood, the villager who drops your 140th wood will walk to build your stable by the time he arrives at ovoo you should have 150 he will return to gathering wood after. shiftclick the commands
1@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@@resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_food.png@, you will try to get to aroudn 9-11 vills on food depending on your build order i like to shoot for 10

1@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@@resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_food.png@, If all has gone well with your build order, RNG can affect the build delay up to 15-20 seconds. you will have finished your age up and have this villager split and 2@unit_mongols/keshik-2.png@ in production.

description:
The fastest way to age up as Mongols, a raw build for getting keshik out ASAP. no particular build after this opening.

If the BO is a little convulated let me know what can be changed in the comments and ill modify
